object.name: base
object.prompt:
Animate this ground impact effect as one continuous pixel-art RPG VFX.

A powerful physical Ground Slam hits the exact center point of the ground. Start with a tiny bright impact flash, then rapidly expand cracks outward from the same center. Small rocks and debris burst upward at peak impact, then fall back down. End with dust, small debris, and the impact fading away.

IMPORTANT:
Keep the impact center locked in exactly the same position for the entire animation.
Keep the same camera angle, perspective, canvas size, scale, and ground contact point.
The effect must evolve continuously from the same impact, not become different separate drawings.
The crater must NOT move or jump between frames.
Do not create multiple examples, multiple impacts, a contact sheet, or separate variations.
Do not add a character, weapon, text, frame numbers, grass, or background scenery.

True handcrafted pixel art, crisp hard pixels, transparent background, no blur, no anti-aliasing.
Physical earth impact only: warm cream impact flash, brown dirt, rocks, cracks and dust.
Designed for an isometric fantasy RPG.
